outcome: serum concentrations of nucleated red blood cells (NRBC)
cohort: The cohort consisted of neonates diagnosed with moderate to severe neonatal encephalopathy, subdivided based on the presence and type of sentinel events.
finding: Absolute nucleated red blood cell (NRBC) concentrations peaked between 17.56 and 39.81 hours after birth depending on the sentinel event group, and these peaks correlated with the severity of grey and white matter injury and lower admission pH.
followup_time: Approximately 40 hours after birth (to capture peak NRBC levels)
